integrity: All finite verification is explicitly separated from the infinite structural argument; no claim of independent certification or absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: Complete groups are proved for clique bouquets with peripheral clique order at least two; arbitrary block graphs, directed covers and historical-priority exhaustiveness are outside the result. Qualitative instability for multiple triangular blades is already implied by an established construction.
title: Exact double-cover automorphism groups and stability thresholds for clique bouquets
